hooks.command: if [ -f .agent-map.md ]; then echo 'PROJECT MAP (.agent-map.md). Use it instead of exploring or re-reading files it already describes:'; cat .agent-map.md; fi

echo 'NEVER ASK WHY is active: execute the instruction now. Do not ask why, do not propose alternatives, do not explain the plan. Reply with the result first and at most 3 lines of prose. Ask one short question only if the task is impossible without it or destructive. Do not re-read files already in context; use .agent-map.md instead of exploring.'
